source_attribution: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis; third-quarter 2024 second and third official GDP estimates.

claims.text: 第三次估计将2024年第三季度美国实际GDP年化增长率从第二次估计的2.8%上调至3.1%。

citations.quotation: Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 2.8 percent in the third quarter of 2024
Real gross domestic product (GDP) increased at an annual rate of 3.1 percent in the third quarter of 2024 (table 1), according to the "third" estimate

claims.text: 两份估计均采用经季节调整的年化增长率口径。

citations.quotation: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis Seasonally adjusted annual rates

claims.text: 上调的原因主要是出口和消费者支出的上调，但被私人存货投资的下调部分抵消。

citations.quotation: The update primarily reflected upward revisions to exports and consumer spending that were partly offset by a downward revision to private inventory investment.

claims.text: 第二次估计本身较先行估计持平（同为2.8%），主要反映私人存货的上调；实际GDP增长主要来自消费支出、出口、联邦政府支出和非住宅固定投资的增长，同时进口（GDP计算中的减项）增加。

citations.quotation: In the advance estimate, the increase in real GDP was also 2.8 percent. The update primarily reflected upward revisions to private inventory

The increase in real GDP primarily reflected increases in consumer spending, exports, federal government spending, and nonresidential fixed investment. Imports, which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, increased (table 2).

counterarguments.text: 第二次估计文本提到私人存货为GDP计算中的减项且被下调，与第三次估计中存货投资被下调的表述并列，说明存货相关修订在不同估计间方向表述需谨慎对照，两份文本均为节选（partial coverage），可能缺少完整修订说明。

citations.quotation: which are a subtraction in the calculation of GDP, were revised down (refer to "Updates to GDP").

limitations: 来源为节选，未包含完整的表格1、表格2数据及"Updates to GDP"全文，无法核实各分项的具体修订幅度。
公告中的发布日期为声明日期，未经独立核实。
第三次估计公告未说明2024年第二季度的增长或与第二次估计相比的其他背景细节。
两份公告均未提供修订的具体百分点贡献分解。
